+package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive
+
+import java.security.MessageDigest
+import java.util.Locale
+
+/**
+ * Research-only, read-only evidence binding. Does NOT validate the truth of an
+ * archive entry or prove an arbitrary model paraphrase. The existing trusted
+ * archive reader must have checked provenance before setting sourceValidated.
+ *
+ * A source SHA attests to excerpt bytes; it is not proof of factual correctness.
+ * This binder deliberately rejects free paraphrases and invented citation IDs.
+ * It is NOT wired into the production CDX1 generator or acceptance benchmark.
+ */
+internal object Cdx1EvidenceSlotBinder {
+    data class ArchivePassage(
+        val canonicalId: String,
+        val excerpt: String,
+        val excerptSha256: String,
+        val sourceValidated: Boolean
+    )
+
+    data class Bundle internal constructor(
+        val promptEvidence: String,
+        internal val slots: Map<String, ArchivePassage>
+    )
+
+    data class ExactQuoteBinding(
+        val answerText: String,
+        val canonicalId: String,
+        val excerptSha256: String,
+        val citation: String
+    )
+
+    fun create(passages: List<ArchivePassage>): Bundle {
+        val eligible = passages.asSequence()
+            .filter {
+                it.sourceValidated &&
+                    it.canonicalId.matches(Regex("[a-zA-Z0-9._:-]{1,160}")) &&
+                    it.excerpt.length in 4..1200 &&
+                    it.excerpt.none { c -> c == '\u0000' } &&
+                    sha256(it.excerpt) == it.excerptSha256.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
+            }
+            .distinctBy { it.canonicalId }
+            .take(3)
+            .toList()
+        val slots = linkedMapOf<String, ArchivePassage>()
+        val block = buildString {
+            append("UNGEPRÜFTE FAKTENBEHAUPTUNGEN AUS INTEGRITÄTSGEPRÜFTEN QUELLTEXTEN:\n")
+            for ((index, item) in eligible.withIndex()) {
+                val slot = "Q" + (index + 1)
+                slots[slot] = item
+                append("[").append(slot).append("] ")
+                    .append(item.excerpt.replace("\r", " ").replace("\n", " "))
+                    .append("\n")
+            }
+        }
+        return Bundle(block, slots.toMap())
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Only a verbatim excerpt span, immediately followed by a known slot,
+     * can receive the corresponding canonical ID. Any unsupported claim is
+     * rejected, never "repaired" with an unrelated reference.
+     */
+    fun bindExactQuote(response: String, bundle: Bundle): ExactQuoteBinding? {
+        if (response.length !in 8..520) return null
+        val match = Regex("""(?s)^(.{4,512}?)\s*\[(Q[1-3])\]\s*$""")
+            .matchEntire(response.trim()) ?: return null
+        val claim = match.groupValues[1].trim()
+        if (claim.length < 4 || claim.any { it == '\n' || it == '\r' || it == '\u0000' }) return null
+        val source = bundle.slots[match.groupValues[2]] ?: return null
+        val wholeSpan = Regex(
+            """(?iu)(?<![\p{L}\p{N}])""" + Regex.escape(claim) + """(?![\p{L}\p{N}])"""
+        )
+        if (!wholeSpan.containsMatchIn(source.excerpt)) return null
+        return ExactQuoteBinding(
+            answerText = claim,
+            canonicalId = source.canonicalId,
+            excerptSha256 = source.excerptSha256,
+            citation = "[Quelle: " + source.canonicalId + "]"
+        )
+    }
+
+    internal fun sha256(text: String): String =
+        MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(text.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
+            .joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it.toInt() and 0xff) }
+}

+/**
+ * Owner-turn network veto. Pure policy, no model output and no tool dispatch.
+ *
+ * A positive network setting or an armed Web button does not override an
+ * explicit same-turn prohibition. Ambiguous mixed instructions fail closed:
+ * the owner may submit a new, unambiguous request separately.
+ *
+ * This recognizes a bounded set of instructions, not arbitrary German
+ * semantics. It never grants internet access or any other capability.
+ */
+internal object NetworkTurnConstraint {
+    private val without = Regex(
+        """(?iu)\bohne(?:\s+(?:jede|jegliche|jeglichen|eine|einen|externen|externe))?\s+(?:internet(?:recherche|suche|zugriff|verbindung)?|web(?:recherche|suche|zugriff)?|online(?:recherche|suche)?|netz(?:werk)?(?:zugriff)?|cloud(?:zugriff)?)\b"""
+    )
+    private val noCapability = Regex(
+        """(?iu)\bkein(?:e|en|es|em|er)?\s+(?:internet(?:recherche|suche|zugriff)?|web(?:recherche|suche|zugriff)?|online(?:recherche|suche)?|netz(?:werk)?zugriff|cloudzugriff)\b"""
+    )
+    private val negativeVerb = Regex(
+        """(?iu)\b(?:suche|such|recherchiere|recherchier|nutze|verwende|benutze|öffne|oeffne|verwende)\s+(?:(?:bitte|jetzt|dabei)\s+)?nicht\s+(?:(?:im|ins|das|die|den|dem)\s+)?(?:internet|web|netz|online|browser|cloud)\b"""
+    )
+    private val negativeAction = Regex(
+        """(?iu)\bnicht\s+(?:(?:mehr|bitte|direkt)\s+)?(?:(?:im|ins)\s+)?(?:internet|web|netz|online|browser|cloud)\s+(?:suchen|recherchieren|nachschlagen|surfen|nutzen|verwenden|gehen)\b"""
+    )
+    private val negativeMedium = Regex(
+        """(?iu)\b(?:nicht|niemals|keinesfalls)\s+(?:(?:ins|im|auf|das)\s+)?(?:internet|web|online|cloud)\b"""
+    )
+    private val localOnly = Regex(
+        """(?iu)\b(?:antworte|beantworte|arbeite|bleib|bleibe|denke|denk|nutze|suche|such|recherchiere|recherchier)\s+(?:bitte\s+)?(?:(?:nur|ausschließlich)\s+)?(?:offline|lokal|gerätelokal)\b"""
+    )
+    // "nicht nur lokal" is explicitly NOT an offline-only constraint.
+    private val onlyLocal = Regex("""(?iu)(?<!nicht\s)\b(?:nur|ausschließlich)\s+(?:lokal|gerätelokal|offline)\b""")
+    private val explicitBlockedCapability = Regex(
+        """(?iu)\b(?:internet(?:recherche|suche|zugriff)?|web(?:recherche|suche|zugriff)?|online(?:recherche|suche)?|cloud(?:zugriff)?|netz(?:werk)?(?:zugriff)?)\s+(?:(?:ist|bleibt)\s+)?(?:verboten|untersagt|gesperrt|deaktiviert)\b"""
+    )
+    private val noConnection = Regex("""(?iu)\bverbinde\s+(?:dich\s+)?nicht\s+mit\s+dem\s+internet\b""")
+    private val explicitOfflineAnswer = Regex(
+        """(?iu)\b(?:antworte|beantworte|arbeite|erkläre|loese|löse)\b[^.!?;]{0,48}\boffline\b"""
+    )
+
+    fun forbidsExternalResearch(userTurn: String): Boolean {
+        // Oversized text cannot become an implicit web authorization.
+        if (userTurn.length > 8192) return true
+        val text = userTurn.trim().lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
+        return without.containsMatchIn(text) ||
+            noCapability.containsMatchIn(text) ||
+            negativeVerb.containsMatchIn(text) ||
+            negativeAction.containsMatchIn(text) ||
+            negativeMedium.containsMatchIn(text) ||
+            localOnly.containsMatchIn(text) ||
+            onlyLocal.containsMatchIn(text) ||
+            explicitBlockedCapability.containsMatchIn(text) ||
+            noConnection.containsMatchIn(text) ||
+            explicitOfflineAnswer.containsMatchIn(text)
+    }
+}

+package at.heinz.deviceai.learning.span
+
+import java.security.MessageDigest
+
+/**
+ * Research-only, conservative baseline for a named person's location.
+ * Does not train, persist, call a model, authorize tools or alter owner state.
+ * This is NOT a learned neural decoder or general language understanding.
+ */
+object EvidenceBoundNaturalLocationProbe {
+    data class Evidence(val sourceId: String, val revision: Int, val sha256: String, val text: String)
+    sealed class Decision {
+        data class Found(
+            val text: String,
+            val sourceId: String,
+            val revision: Int,
+            val sha256: String,
+            val start: Int,
+            val endExclusive: Int
+        ) : Decision()
+        data class Abstained(val reason: String) : Decision()
+    }
+
+    private val questionPattern = Regex(
+        """(?iu)^\s*wo\s+(?:ist|wohnt|lebt|steht)\s+([\p{L}][\p{L}\p{M}-]{1,31})\s*\?\s*$"""
+    )
+    private val contradictoryWords = Regex("""(?iu)\b(?:nicht|kein|keine|sondern|stattdessen)\b""")
+    private val timeWords = Regex(
+        """(?iu)\b(?:gestern|heute|morgen|früher|damals|aktuell|seit|vorher|später)\b"""
+    )
+    private val validId = Regex("[a-zA-Z0-9._:-]{1,96}")
+    private val validSha = Regex("[0-9a-f]{64}")
+    private const val cityPattern =
+        """[\p{Lu}][\p{L}\p{M}-]{1,40}(?:\s+[\p{Lu}][\p{L}\p{M}-]{1,40}){0,2}"""
+
+    fun digest(text: String): String =
+        MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(text.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
+            .joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
+
+    fun answer(question: String, sources: List<Evidence>): Decision {
+        if (question.length > 160 || question.any(Char::isISOControl) ||

+/**

+ * An unsupported page is not a verified statute and yields no evidence.

+internal class LegalRisEvidenceProvider(private val upstream: ResearchProvider): ResearchProvider {
+    override fun retrieve(request: ResearchRequest): ResearchResult {
+        val actual = upstream.retrieve(request)
+        val expectedParagraph = LegalRisParagraphExtractor.paragraphNumber(request.url)
+            ?: return actual
+        val cleaned = actual.documents.mapNotNull { doc ->
+            if (LegalRisParagraphExtractor.paragraphNumber(doc.url) != expectedParagraph)
+                return@mapNotNull null
+            val text = LegalRisParagraphExtractor.extract(expectedParagraph, doc.content)
+                ?: return@mapNotNull null
+            val sha = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
+                .digest(text.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
+                .joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
+            doc.copy(content=text, contentHash=sha, mimeType="text/plain")
+        }
+        return ResearchResult(cleaned, cleaned.map { it.citation() })
+    }
+}
+
+internal object LegalRisParagraphExtractor {
+    // URL host and paths must be exact RIS resources, not a lookalike or search engine.
+    fun paragraphNumber(url: String): String? {
+        val uri = runCatching { URI(url) }.getOrNull() ?: return null
+        val host = uri.host?.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) ?: return null
+        if (uri.scheme != "https" || host !in setOf("www.ris.bka.gv.at","ris.bka.gv.at") ||
+            uri.userInfo != null || uri.port !in setOf(-1,443)) return null
+        val path = uri.path.orEmpty()
+        val text = if (path.startsWith("/eli/", true)) path
+            else if (path.equals("/NormDokument.wxe", true)) uri.rawQuery.orEmpty()
+            else return null
+        return Regex("""(?iu)(?:/P|(?:^|&)Paragraf=)([0-9]{1,5})(?:/|&|$)""")
+            .find(text)?.groupValues?.get(1)
+    }
+
+    /** This is a partial-evidence extractor, not legal interpretation or current-law oracle. */
+    fun extract(paragraph: String, raw: String): String? {
+        if (!paragraph.matches(Regex("[0-9]{1,5}")) || raw.length !in 100..100_000)
+            return null
+        val heading = Regex("""(?iu)§\s*""" + Regex.escape(paragraph) + """(?:[.\s]|$)""")
+        // Metadata can mention "Dokumentnummer" before the actual Text section.
+        // Only treat section trailers *following* "Text" as delimiters.
+        val textField = Regex("""(?iu)\bText\s*:?""").find(raw)
+            ?.range?.last?.plus(1) ?: return null
+        val firstTrailer = listOf("Schlagworte", "Zuletzt aktualisiert", "Dokumentnummer", "European Legislation Identifier")
+            .map { raw.indexOf(it, startIndex = textField, ignoreCase = true) }
+            .filter { it >= 0 }.minOrNull() ?: raw.length
+        val candidates = heading.findAll(raw)
+            .filter { it.range.first in textField until firstTrailer }.toList()
+        val match = candidates.lastOrNull() ?: return null
+        val segment = raw.substring(match.range.first, firstTrailer)
+            .replace(Regex("""\s+"""), " ").trim().take(10_000)
+        if (segment.length < 80 || !Regex("""(?iu)(?:\(\s*1\s*\)|\bAbsatz\s+(?:eins|1)\b|\b1\))""")
+                .containsMatchIn(segment)) return null
+        return segment
+    }
+}

+internal object TemporalRoleEvidenceLedger {
+    data class Fact(val subject: String, val relation: String, val value: String,
+        val validFromMillis: Long, val observedAtMillis: Long,
+        val sourceId: String, val sourceRevision: Int, val sourceText: String,
+        val sourceSha256: String, val validUntilMillis: Long? = null,
+        val supersedesSourceIds: Set<String> = emptySet()) {
+        init {
+            require(subject.length in 1..80 && relation.length in 1..80 && value.length in 1..160)
+            require(subject.none(Char::isISOControl) && value.none(Char::isISOControl))
+            require(validFromMillis >= 0 && observedAtMillis >= 0)
+            require(validUntilMillis == null || validUntilMillis > validFromMillis)
+            require(sourceId.matches(Regex("[a-zA-Z0-9._:-]{1,96}")) && sourceRevision > 0)
+            require(sourceText.length in 1..4096)
+            require(sourceSha256.matches(Regex("[a-f0-9]{64}")))
+            require(sourceSha256 == sha256(sourceText))
+            require(supersedesSourceIds.size <= 16 &&
+                supersedesSourceIds.none { it == sourceId ||
+                    !it.matches(Regex("[a-zA-Z0-9._:-]{1,96}")) })
+        }
+    }
+
+    sealed class Lookup {
+        data class Found(val value: String, val sources: List<String>, val validFromMillis: Long): Lookup()
+        data class Conflict(val sourceIds: List<String>): Lookup()
+        object NoEvidence: Lookup()
+    }
+
+    fun lookup(facts: Collection<Fact>, subject: String, relation: String,
+               validAtMillis: Long, knownAtMillis: Long): Lookup {
+        require(facts.size <= 256 && validAtMillis >= 0 && knownAtMillis >= 0)
+        val relevant = facts.asSequence()
+            .filter { it.subject.trim().lowercase(Locale.ROOT) == subject.trim().lowercase(Locale.ROOT) &&
+                it.relation.trim().lowercase(Locale.ROOT) == relation.trim().lowercase(Locale.ROOT) &&
+                it.validFromMillis <= validAtMillis && it.observedAtMillis <= knownAtMillis &&
+                (it.validUntilMillis == null || validAtMillis < it.validUntilMillis) }
+            .toList()
+        if (relevant.isEmpty()) return Lookup.NoEvidence
+        // A later timestamp is NOT authority to erase a conflicting source.
+        // New location values supersede older active values only when the new
+        // evidence explicitly identifies the older source being replaced.
+        val latest = relevant.maxOf { it.validFromMillis }
+        val candidates = relevant.filter { it.validFromMillis == latest }
+        val allValues = candidates.map { it.value.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) }.distinct()
+        val oldConflicts = relevant.filter { fact ->
+            fact.validFromMillis < latest &&
+                fact.value.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) !in allValues &&
+                candidates.none { fact.sourceId in it.supersedesSourceIds }
+        }
+        if (allValues.size != 1 || oldConflicts.isNotEmpty())
+            return Lookup.Conflict((candidates + oldConflicts).map { it.sourceId }.distinct().sorted())
+        return Lookup.Found(candidates.first().value, candidates.map { it.sourceId }.distinct().sorted(), latest)
+    }
+
+    fun sha256(text: String): String =
+        MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
+            .digest(text.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)).joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
+}
